Galette Des Rois

Served at: Epiphany (Three Kings Day)

Serves 8Prep 20 minCook 30 min

Galette des Rois, or King's Cake, is a traditional French pastry served to celebrate Epiphany on January 6th, marking the visit of the Magi to the Christ child. This flaky puff pastry cake is filled with rich almond cream and often contains a hidden fève (a small trinket), with the person who finds it crowned king or queen for the day.

Ingredients

  • 2 sheets of puff pastry (about 8.5 oz or 240 g each)
  • 1 cup (100 g) almond flour
  • 1/2 cup (100 g) granulated sugar
  • 1/2 cup (115 g) unsalted butter, softened
  • 2 large eggs
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • 1 tablespoon all-purpose flour
  • 1 egg yolk (for egg wash)
  • 1 small fève or whole almond (optional)

Method

  1. Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C).
  2. In a bowl, cream together the softened butter and sugar until smooth.
  3. Add the almond flour, all-purpose flour, vanilla extract, and one whole egg to the butter mixture; mix until well combined to make the almond cream filling.
  4. Place one sheet of puff pastry on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
  5. Spread the almond cream evenly over the puff pastry, leaving about a 1-inch (2.5 cm) border around the edges.
  6. If using, hide the fève or whole almond somewhere in the almond cream.
  7. Brush the border of the puff pastry with beaten egg yolk.
  8. Place the second sheet of puff pastry on top and gently press the edges to seal them together.
  9. Use a fork to crimp the edges for a decorative seal.
  10. With a sharp knife, lightly score the top in a circular or diamond pattern, being careful not to cut through the pastry.
  11. Brush the top with the remaining egg yolk for a golden finish.
  12. Bake for 25-30 minutes or until the pastry is puffed and golden brown.
  13. Let cool slightly before serving.

Tips

  • Chill the assembled galette in the refrigerator for 15 minutes before baking to prevent puff pastry shrinkage.
  • Serve warm or at room temperature with a cup of tea or coffee.
  • For a twist, add a tablespoon of rum or orange blossom water to the almond cream for extra flavor.
